note: Motonari on his deathbed with Kikkawa Motoharu, Kobayakawa Takakage and the young Terumoto. The last two lines are the uncles' reply (one each). Japanese transcribed with faster-whisper large-v3 (tools/transcribe_movie.py, clips re-run with tools/transcribe_clip.py) and corrected by context and the frames; times in seconds from the start of the film (frame = round(t * 15) + 1). Speaker names are notes only (not shown).

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: Do you remember the Lesson of the Three Arrows?

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Terumoto
subtitles.en: Yes, of course. My late father told me of it as well.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: The Lesson of the Three Arrows holds only when all three houses stand together.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: Terumoto, without the Two Rivers, the Kikkawa and the Kobayakawa, the Mouri cannot prosper.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: Motoharu, Takakage... I leave Terumoto in your care.

subtitles.speaker: Motoharu / Takakage
subtitles.en: We will serve him with our lives.
